intent.raw: Use the AutoAds auto-research pattern and the Anime.js ontology so we can try to animate the ontology video animations.
intent.objective: Run the canonical Refine loop to design an evidence-bound animation-hypothesis consultation flow and a non-executed Work Pack for one narrow ontology-video prototype.
intent.operator_sentence: Design how AutoAds-style candidate research and the Anime.js vault can guide an ontology-video animation prototype without implementing or rendering it yet.

technique_overlays.trigger: The canonical ten-stage Refine route must preserve typed handoffs and validation receipts.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every stage produces an artifact and native parent receipt or an explicit blocker.

technique_overlays.trigger: The frozen picture score does not yet identify motion layers, executable primitives, or evidence-state transitions.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The design names source beats, layers, Anime.js evidence, motion primitives, witnesses, and ownership boundaries.

technique_overlays.trigger: Several scenes and first-prototype cuts are plausible and must be compared before planning.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: At least three candidate scenes are scored, rejected alternatives remain visible, and the selected unit recomposes into the full film.

technique_overlays.trigger: A paper design can hide semantic drift and reduced-motion failures before implementation.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: A finite beat-state fixture demonstrates how candidate, selected plan, executed witness, failure, and residue differ.

technique_overlays.trigger: Animation decisions and failed experiments must remain recoverable across later Task Sessions.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Open gaps, rejected scenes, failed hypotheses, and future WorkEpisode handles retain owner and next route.

route_menu.context_hint: Use candidate research to plan one evidence-bound prototype before extending across the film.

items.label: Scene candidate loop
items.description: Generate, consult, review, select, test, and retain residue for one bounded scene.

items.label: Whole-film direct implementation
items.description: Rejected because it skips a falsifiable scene witness and compounds untested layering, timing, semantic, and accessibility assumptions.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The user confirmed three independent source, candidate-model, and motion-design roles.
subagent_strategy.explanation: The lanes must disagree before the parent selects a scene and synthesizes the design.

roles.purpose: Freeze source-owned scene, beat, timing, image, and claim boundaries.
roles.owns: A read-only source-authority receipt for parent synthesis.

roles.purpose: Adapt the AutoAds candidate research contract without inheriting advertising metrics or runtime claims.
roles.owns: A read-only AnimationHypothesisCandidate and lifecycle receipt for parent synthesis.

roles.purpose: Map candidate scenes to Anime.js evidence, motion primitives, and falsifiable acceptance contracts.
roles.owns: A read-only motion-design receipt for parent synthesis.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Confirmed in chat: run the three source-authority, auto-research-adapter, and animejs-motion-designer roles.

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: Block if the source video, AutoAds precedent, or Anime.js vault boundary cannot be verified.

steps.name: Invoke Define animation research loop
stop_conditions: Flag if proof states or owner decisions collapse.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review
stop_conditions: Flag unresolved blocker-level choices; do not ask preference questions that evidence can resolve.

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: External research requires separate confirmation; local evidence is the default.

steps.name: Distill the coherent scene research unit
stop_conditions: Block if a scene-level unit cannot recompose into the frozen 12-sequence order.

steps.name: Invoke Design role-bound fanout
convergence_criteria: All three role receipts join or an explicit blocker stops synthesis.
At least three scenes are compared.
The selected prototype has exact evidence, acceptance, reduced-motion, and recomposition contracts.
stop_conditions: Block on a missing role receipt or semantic-source conflict.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review
stop_conditions: Flag decorative relations, unfalsifiable witnesses, missing reduced motion, or authority collapse.

steps.name: Distill repair of design gaps
stop_conditions: Block if an acceptance-critical gap cannot be repaired or explicitly deferred.

steps.name: Invoke Plan non-executed prototype Work Pack
stop_conditions: Block if the plan lacks a nearest reversible first unit, exact checks, and Task Session entry criteria.

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine synthesis
stop_conditions: Block if the seed done criteria are not satisfied or if planning is misstated as implementation.

boundaries.contract: Narration, caption order, semantic claims, timing posture, and eight image worlds are selected read-only source evidence.
Adapt candidate and review semantics; do not import advertising metrics, runtime claims, or promotion authority.
Vault evidence may guide planned primitives; only later executed browser witnesses can prove runtime behavior.

promotion_splits.rule: requires finite tournament and parent owner selection
requires later executed witness; Lesson remains separately admitted

gates.condition: All three confirmed role receipts pass and are joined before parent synthesis.
Source, documentation, planned motion, executed witness, subjective evaluation, and owner decision remain distinct.
At least three bounded scenes are compared and rejection reasons are retained.
Every selected motion beat has a semantic reduced-motion equivalent.
No animation implementation, rendering, voice operation, deployment, or publication is claimed.

promotion_guardrails: Anime.js vault consultation is not runtime behavior proof.
The video package remains source-owned and unmodified.
This run grants no ontology authority, implementation, render, publication, release, deployment, or production readiness.
